title: Bookkeeper
company: Jobsworth Recruitment Solutions LTD - Agency - Permanent
description:
Bookkeeper

Location: Gloucester
Salary: £30,000 £35,500
Hours: Full-time, Permanent

Are you an experienced Bookkeeper looking for a role where you can take ownership of the finance function and really make an impact?

We're working with a growing, well-established business in Gloucester that is looking for a confident and organised Head Bookkeeper / Company Accountant to join its friendly team.

This is a fantastic opportunity to become a key part of a successful SME, working closely with the Directors and taking responsibility for the day-to-day accounts, financial reporting and supporting the continued growth of the business.

The Role

You'll be responsible for ensuring the smooth running of the finance function, with duties including:
- Managing day-to-day bookkeeping using Xero
- Processing sales and purchase invoices, expenses and bank reconciliations
- Managing CIS returns, subcontractor payments and deductions
- Preparing VAT returns, including domestic reverse charge
- Producing monthly management accounts, P&L reports and cash flow summaries
- Monitoring aged debtors, creditors and payment schedules
- Managing project costs, retentions and contract profitability
- Processing payroll journals and supporting payroll activities
- Preparing financial information and reports for the Directors
- Maintaining accurate financial records and ensuring HMRC compliance

About You

We're looking for someone who is confident managing a busy accounts function and enjoys having responsibility for their own workload.

Ideally, you'll have:
- Previous experience in a Bookkeeper, Senior Bookkeeper or Company Accountant role
- Strong working knowledge of Xero
- Experience with CIS and construction industry accounting
- Good understanding of VAT, including domestic reverse charge
- Experience preparing management accounts and financial reports
- Strong Excel skills and excellent attention to detail
- AAT Level 4 qualification or equivalent experience (desirable)
- A proactive, organised and hands-on approach

Experience within construction, property services, engineering or a similar project-based environment would be particularly beneficial.

What's on Offer?
- Salary of £30,000 £35,500
- Permanent, full-time position
- Friendly, supportive working environment
- Opportunity to take ownership of the accounts function
- Further training and professional development
- Company pension
- Free onsite parking
- Employee discounts and company events

Interested?

If you're an experienced Bookkeeper who enjoys variety, responsibility and being a valued part of a growing business, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Domiciliary care coordinator
description:
Domiciliary Care Coordinator

Location: Gloucestershire
Start Date: ASAP
Salary: £28,000 £34,000 per annum (depending on experience)
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

About Verity Healthcare

Verity Healthcare Limited is a trusted domiciliary care provider delivering high-quality, person-centred care to individuals in their own homes. We work closely with local authorities, the NHS, CCGs, private hospitals, and private clients to help people maintain independence and dignity within their own homes.

Due to continued growth, we are looking for an organised, compassionate, and proactive care coordinator to join our team.

The Role

As a Care Coordinator, you will play a key role in ensuring the smooth day-to-day running of care services. You will be responsible for coordinating care staff rotas, liaising with service users and care workers, and ensuring care is delivered safely, efficiently, and in line with CQC standards.

This is a fast-paced, office-based role that requires excellent organisation, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Key Responsibilities
- Creating and managing staff rotas using care scheduling systems
- Allocating care workers to service users based on needs and location
- Responding to staff absences and arranging emergency cover
- Liaising with service users, families, and care staff daily
- Monitoring care delivery to ensure high standards are maintained
- Updating care plans and maintaining accurate records
- Supporting the Care Manager with compliance and CQC requirements
- Conducting spot checks, supervisions, and field support when required
- Handling incoming calls, queries, and concerns professionally
- Ensuring continuity of care for all service users

Skills & Experience Required
- Previous experience in a domiciliary care setting (essential)
- Experience in care coordination or scheduling (desirable)
- Strong understanding of CQC regulations and care standards
- Excellent organisational and time-management skills
- Ability to work under pressure and solve problems quickly
- Good IT skills and experience with care management systems
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
- Full UK driving licence (desirable)

What We Offer
- Supportive and friendly working environment
- Ongoing training and professional development
- Career progression opportunities
- Pension scheme
- Employee Assistance Programme
- Paid training and CPD

Why Join Verity Healthcare?

You will be joining a team that values kindness, accountability, excellence, and passion. Your work will directly impact the quality of care our service users receive every day.

Safer Recruitment & Equal Opportunities

All successful applicants will be subject to:
- Enhanced DBS check
- Right to work verification
- Reference and qualification checks

Verity Healthcare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

How to Apply

Please apply with your CV and a short cover letter outlining your experience in domiciliary care and coordination

We are committed to equality, diversity and inclusion and welcome applications from all sections of the community.
As part of our commitment to the Disability Confident scheme, we actively encourage applications from individuals with disabilities and long-term conditions.
If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know.

As a Service Advisor, you will be responsible for managing the customer journey from initial booking through to vehicle collection. You will coordinate workshop appointments, keep customers updated on repair progress, provide estimates, and gain approval for any additional work required.

- Identify customer requirements and provide accurate, fully inclusive cost estimates
- Produce accurate job cards, invoices, estimates, and related documentation
- Explain completed work clearly and identify opportunities to promote additional services
- Gain customer approval for any additional work required
- Maintain accurate workshop loading and scheduling information
- Produce warranty job cards in line with manufacturer policies and procedures
- Correctly record retail, warranty, internal, and non-chargeable repairs
- Liaise with the Parts Department to ensure required parts are available

This role will suit you if you have:
- Previous experience in a Service Advisor role (preferred)
- Experience working in an administration or office-based environment
- Excellent communication and customer service skills
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks
